title: English 6th Grade — Digital Coursebook Companion (ΣΤ΄ Δημοτικού)
curriculum: Greek Ministry of Education (DEPPS-APS) / ITYE Diophantus
target_audience: 11-12 year old EFL Primary Learners & Teachers
teacher_syllabus_notice: Note for Teachers & Authors: Unit titles, grammatical foci, and themes for Units 2–10 represent preliminary syllabus mapping and should be verified against the physical 6th Grade Coursebook and Teacher's Book before authoring content for those units.

units.title: Our Multicultural Class
units.tagline: Meeting newcomers, European geography, habits vs. present situations, country reports
units.grammar: Present Simple, Adverbs of Frequency, Present Continuous

units.title: Going Shopping
units.tagline: Supermarkets, malls, canteen menus, expressing quantity, and e-shopping
units.theme: Consumer Education, Health Education, Decision Making
units.grammar: Countable/Uncountable Nouns, a/an, Some/Any, How much/many, Verbs of the Senses, a little/a few, Order of Adjectives

units.title: Imaginary Creatures
units.tagline: Fairy tale heroes, monsters, Shakespeare's Midsummer Night's Dream, personality traits
units.grammar: Comparison of Adjectives & Adverbs, Opposites with Suffixes

units.title: The History of the Aeroplane
units.tagline: Daedalus & Icarus, Wright Brothers, aviation history, narrating past events
units.theme: Progress, Change, Inventions, Forces of Flight
units.grammar: Past Simple, Past Continuous, Time Linkers (when, while, after that)

units.title: Travelling Through Time
units.tagline: Diaries, songs, museum visits, transportation rules, and asking for directions
units.theme: Time & Place, Local History, Music, Road Safety
units.grammar: Used to (past habits), Asking for & Giving Directions, Informal Letter Phrases

units.title: Me, Myself and My Future Job
units.tagline: Careers, job interviews, personal traits, safety rules, and future goals
units.grammar: Modal Verbs (can, may, should), Future Tenses (will, going to)

units.title: Share Your Experiences
units.tagline: Life experiences, world records, Paralympics champions, personal bests, and duration of events
units.grammar: Present Perfect Simple & Continuous, For & Since

units.title: Blow Your Own Trumpet
units.tagline: Music festivals, instruments, pocket money survey, and giving advice
units.theme: Music, Financial Literacy, Stereotypes, Conflict Resolution

units.title: Earth Day Everyday
units.tagline: Environmental protection, endangered species, pollutants, and green action
units.grammar: Past Perfect Simple, Clauses of Reason & Result

units.title: Time for Fun
units.tagline: Cinema, books, film reviews, super spies, and expressing preferences
